recognition.network: No connection to {{provider}}. Check the network.
recognition.answerNotJson: The model's answer contains no tag data.
recognition.notAnImage: The selected file is not an image.
recognition.noApiKey: Enter an API key for {{provider}} in settings.
recognition.noModel: No model available for {{provider}}. Refresh the list in settings.

upload.notConfigured: Network share is not set up: enter the server, shared folder and table path in Settings → Storage.
upload.targetUnsupported: Only the network share is supported for now. Choose it in Settings → Storage.
upload.invalidPath: The table path must end with .xlsx, e.g. Probe si Sarje Otel\Probe otel.xlsx.
upload.unavailable: Writing to the network share works only in the mobile app.
upload.hostUnreachable: Server {{host}} is not responding. Check the address, the Wi-Fi network and that port 445 is open.
upload.timeout: The server took too long to respond.
upload.authFailed: The server rejected the user name or password.
upload.shareNotFound: Shared folder “{{share}}” was not found on {{host}}.
upload.notFound: The file or folder was not found on the share.
upload.accessDenied: No permission to read or write the table. Check the account rights on the shared folder.
upload.locked: The table is open in another program (Excel). Close it; the upload will retry.
upload.busy: Another device is writing to the table right now. The upload will retry shortly.
upload.corruptWorkbook: The table could not be opened: the file is damaged or is not an .xlsx workbook.
upload.verifyFailed: Verification after saving failed; the upload will retry.
upload.integrityFailed: Upload stopped: re-saving the log would have changed other data. The file was not touched — contact the developer.
upload.unknownLayout: The steel sample log was not found in the table: no header with Nr. Crt., Sarja, Producator, Bobina/Bara columns. Check the file path.
upload.tableNotFound: Table not found. The app does not create the table: point to an existing log in Settings → Storage — the write will be retried after that.
upload.authRequired: No access to Google Drive: sign in with Google in Settings → Storage.
upload.driveNotConfigured: Google sign-in is not set up in this build of the app (no Google OAuth client).
upload.folderNotFound: The Google Drive folder was not found or this account has no access to it.
